claim: PT #395 went green at 8cc496b after three real failures, not because 7f8b834 looked checked: (1) quoted echo of GITHUB_HEAD_REF into GITHUB_OUTPUT made stack-map lookup miss, checkout used the PT branch name on orama-system, continue-on-error fell through to orama main, and endpoint-policy parity compared the wrong tree -- write GITHUB_OUTPUT via --github-output, checkout the open Orama PR 363 branch cursor/tiered-pipeline-runtime-fb76 until that PR merges then use main, and fail declared-peer checkout instead of silent main fallback; diagnose from the job-log fetch refspec, not conclusion=success. (2) Remote orama_bridge Bearer hops need an HTTPS url_checker on every redirect, and packaged endpoint_policy hosts must not treat startswith 127-dot as loopback. (3) Memory-gate tests mint sha256(claim) while learn.py mints cluster.pattern_id(claim, conditions); the hook must accept both tooling mints and still reject invented ids. A SHA with zero Actions runs is not CI green even if CodeRabbit is success.
